changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwDiagnosticOrders AS SELECT dorder.id, dorder.patient_id, dorder.encounter_id, dorder.status, dorder.order_number, dorder.save_draft, dorder.submitted_by, dorder.submitted_date, dorder.is_urgent, dorder.lab_status, dorder.rad_status, dorder.from_department_id, dorder.from_facility_id, dorder.created_date, dorder.created_by, dorder.last_modified_by, dorder.last_modified_date FROM public.diagnostic_orders dorder;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwDiagnosticOrders TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwDiagnosticOrders FROM report_user;
